description: Sony Alpha 6400 mirrorless cameras take imaging far beyond the capability of a DSLR. As powerful as a pro camera, but smaller and easy to use, they turn your everyday shots into beautiful movies and photography to both see and feel. A Sony mirrorless camera, with far larger image sensor and bright lenses, makes better use of the light you have. The smart image processor ensures sharp, low-noise images even without a flash. Its a perfect travel camera for vloggers, travel bloggers and youtubers who are looking for a compact camera with good image quality. Enjoy enhanced shooting comfort with LCD tiltable screen that tilts 180 degree to accommodate shooting at every angle, from low to high and in-between.
